text: Then you're looking in the wrong area. Get lost.

text: You must be one of those wimpy little purple robes. Get out# of here before we blow you away.

You must be one of those wimpy little purple robes. Get out

text: 你一定是那些穿紫色长袍的废物。在我杀了你之前离开这里。
source_text: 你一定是那些穿紫色长袍的废物。在我杀了你之前离开这里。

Wait! I don't know what you're talking about. I'm here for
# Adytum. They want me to get everyone to leave them alone.

text: 等等！我不知道你在说什么。我来这里是那些内城区的家伙要我把所有人都赶走。
source_text: 等等！我不知道你在说什么。我来这里是那些内城区的家伙要我把所有人都赶走。

text: Hmm. If you are really from Adytum, then you are still a loser.# There can never be peace while those Rippers are still around.

Hmm. If you are really from Adytum, then you are still a loser.
# There can never be peace while those Rippers are still around.

text: 嗯，如果你真的来自内城区，你是个败者，如果电锯党在这周围就永远没有和平。
source_text: 嗯，如果你真的来自内城区，你是个败者，如果电锯党在这周围就永远没有和平。

text: Ask Razor. She'll explain about those bloodthirsty inbreds.
source_text: Ask Razor. She'll explain about those bloodthirsty inbreds.

text: 去问问剃刀。她会告诉你关于那些噬血如命的疯子的事儿。
source_text: 去问问剃刀。她会告诉你关于那些噬血如命的疯子的事儿。

text: Hey, now that you are a Blade, I need to ask you a favor.
source_text: Hey, now that you are a Blade, I need to ask you a favor.

text: 嘿，你是利刃帮的人，我得问你一点私事。
source_text: 嘿，你是利刃帮的人，我得问你一点私事。

text: Great. Take this locket to Julianna. Tell her that I hope# to see her soon.
source_text:
Great. Take this locket to Julianna. Tell her that I hope
# to see her soon.

text: 很好。把这个小盒子带给茱莉亚娜。告诉她我希望马上见到她。
source_text: 很好。把这个小盒子带给茱莉亚娜。告诉她我希望马上见到她。

text: It seems that I have fallen for a girl in Adytum. Because of# the Regulators shooting us on sight, I can't get close to her.
source_text:
It seems that I have fallen for a girl in Adytum. Because of
# the Regulators shooting us on sight, I can't get close to her.

text: 她是让我为之倾倒的一个内城区女孩。因为管理者一看到我们就开枪，我不能接近她。
source_text: 她是让我为之倾倒的一个内城区女孩。因为管理者一看到我们就开枪，我不能接近她。

text: If you take this locket to Julianna, I would be in your debt.
source_text: If you take this locket to Julianna, I would be in your debt.

text: 如果你能把这个小盒子带给茱莉亚娜，我会欠你一份人情。
source_text: 如果你能把这个小盒子带给茱莉亚娜，我会欠你一份人情。

text: With allies like you, who needs enemies? Good bye!
source_text: With allies like you, who needs enemies? Good bye!

text: 和你这样的盟友在一起，谁又敢作对？再见！
source_text: 和你这样的盟友在一起，谁又敢作对？再见！

text: I think she loves me too, but I don't know. The Blades won't# risk letting me try to break into Adytum.
source_text:
I think she loves me too, but I don't know. The Blades won't
# risk letting me try to break into Adytum.

text: 我想她也爱我，但是我不确定。利刃帮不敢冒险让我冲进内城区。
source_text: 我想她也爱我，但是我不确定。利刃帮不敢冒险让我冲进内城区。

text: Thank you! She sent me a note. We are going to meet at# the Follower's place and get married.
source_text:
Thank you! She sent me a note. We are going to meet at
# the Follower's place and get married.

text: 谢谢你！她给我递纸条来说，我们要在末世论者的地盘重聚并结婚！
source_text: 谢谢你！她给我递纸条来说，我们要在末世论者的地盘重聚并结婚！

text: Thank you so much. We will stay here with the Followers now,# where we can be happily married.

Thank you so much. We will stay here with the Followers now,
# where we can be happily married.

text: 非常感谢你，我们将会和末世论者一起住在这里，然后幸福的结婚。
